purpose: Classifies each caller-declared funds stream of a UK payment or e-money firm on three questions: whether the funds are relevant funds, whether the safeguarding method asserted for them (segregation under CASS 15.3, or an insurance policy or comparable guarantee under CASS 15.5) is coherent with the designated-account, acknowledgement-letter and instrument facts supplied, and where the supplied facts do not settle the answer. Every judgment_required outcome names what is undetermined, which single input would resolve it, and who decides, so a judgment is never a bare flag. Also computes a SUP 3A safeguarding audit exemption indicator from a relevant funds high-water figure observed over at least 53 weeks. Single-run and stateless. A coherence verdict is a consistency check on the facts as declared, never a determination that the firm has complied with or breached CASS 15, and never an opinion on whether an insurance policy or guarantee is legally effective.

trust_label: deferred -- deterministic source published, zkVM proof not yet generated -- New node landed by CASS15-K-1 as a disjoint shard: the zkVM receipt is generated by the asynchronous GPU proving queue after the shard is folded into chaingraph.json by ASSEMBLE-LAND, because the guest cannot be built against a kernel that is not yet in the assembled monolith. The kernel is fully deterministic and its sha256-source identity is published above, so the proof can be attached without any hash-moving edit.
